notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator 2017 - Now with Steam cards, badges and backgrounds
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Train Mechanics![/h1]

Thank you very much for the warm welcome! While browsing through your posts on the forum, there were a lot of threads about the lack of cards and Steam badges.

We wanted to change that and from now on you will have the opportunity to get them in [b]Train Mechanic Simulator 2017[/b]. Besides, we added some new flashy train theme emoticons that you will be able to use during the Steam chat. Of course, once you unlock them.

We would like to remind you that we are still collecting your suggestions for the next [b]Train Mechanic Simulator.[/b] Can you share your feedback, ideas about the next iteration with us? What's important to you in the game? Which mechanics should we improve? What do you think the new Train Mechanic should look like? Share your thoughts with us on the game's steam forum.


Best Regards,
Atomic Jelly

notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator 2017 Update #4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26651790/e54b5d4caa857a27949520c1542f74eb2782c2a0.jpg[/img]

Hello Players,

As we said before we are listening your comments about our game. Thanks to this we are able to deliver improvements which can improve your experience with our game. Please find below list of changes and fixes:

Changes:

- Add 2 new Music Themes for workshop instead of old ones
- Add new bolts to the parts in steam and electric locomotives
 
Fixes:

- Rear axle leaf spring - now its on mechanic table not electric
- Fix problem with the sound - now problem with lowing music volume with fast muting is fixed
- Music setting should now been saved with the game
- Improved price showing in the mounting menu
- Game Engine Upgraded to most actual version - improved stability

Again - thank you for your feedback and see you on next update!

Devs

notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator 2017 #3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26651790/12d744cf4b727a6d0260a500beda8f76c228c6d7.jpg[/img]

Dear Players,

As we said before we are working hard to deliver fixes and better functionalities to our game. We would like to thank you again for your support that gives us energy to deliver next updates. Please find below changes we made in last patch:

Changes:

- Changes in naming the parts into proper translations
- Time for part fix and communication about sucess and failure had been change. Now it tooks 50% less time to do it
- Major Change in gameplay: Now we can go into any depot we want in any time we want and we can take any task from this depot for a job. Player desides on his own about where to go in his playing time
 
Fixes:

- Fix problem in Steam Depot - when player buys some parts which are not in task the game cannot proceed.

- Small Fixes&Changes

notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26651790/d80ae2eb95889b307876e17d8f478b35a93e7411.jpg[/img]

Dear Players,

We are gratefull for your feedback considering our game. Our development team is working hard to deliver next updates as soon as possible. Sometimes we are facing issues that we have to fix faster; without waiting for next update pack. We call them "Hot Fixes" Please find below changes we made:

Hot Fix#1

- Fixed case with Steam Workshop. After lefting once steam workshop player were unable to come back again. He was sent to electric one. Right now problem had been solved

Thank you for your feedback. See you on next Train Mechanic Simulator Update!

notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator Second Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26651790/dbe0e4596d561dd335512a67e6a8bb28e7e9e0dd.jpg[/img]

Dear Players,

We are working hard to deliver best gameplay quality as we can. This is why we deliver to you second update of our game. Please find below list of changes. We would like to inform you that we are going to continue working about the game.

Patch 2:

- Fixes in naming parts in lockit
- Game Engine Update (improved stability, and performance)
- Fixes in table parts categories (e.g. now fuses are in proper table)
- Camera fixes - now zoom is more deep and allows to see parts from closer distance
- Fixes in crane mechanics
- Some small fixes and improvments

Hope you enjoy it.

Developers
